text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — gpu-pool-us-west3 reached cloud quota limit; autoscaler failed to provision additional GPU nodes, queue growth observed across inference cluster. severity=high, impact=hosted-api generation latency and 5xx increase

maria_g: seeing spike in queue length on us-west3-inference. backlog ~4.2k requests, avg wait > 12s, tokens/sec down ~30%. :eyes:

aj_s: confirmed. autoscaler logs show repeated quotaDenied from GCP, 403 Quota reached when creating instance, error: \"QuotaExceeded: CPUS_EXTENDED_GPUS\". no new replicas being created.

samir_k: any Dedicated customers affected?
ellie_p: Dedicated pools are on reserved capacity in other regions, so far unaffected. only Hosted nodes in us-west3.

priya_m: quick impact estimate: ~11% of generation requests for model-redwood-7b returned 502/503 or timed out in the last 10m. customer support already triaging large customers on hosted tier.

ops_lead: ng — let's triage and start mitigations. steps: 1) validate cloud quota, 2) attempt warm pool claim in alternate region, 3) apply temporary throttles/priorities, 4) open provider quota request. assignable?
maria_g: i can run cloud checks and open support ticket.
aj_s: i'll try routing policy to fall back to us-west2 and ap-southeast1 for stateless requests, update routing policy in 10m.
samir_k: i'll handle customer comms and SLA notes.

k8s-autoscaler-bot: Autoscaler event stream:
```
Autoscaler: scale request queued (req=6 g5.8xlarge)
GCP API: createInstance -> FAILED: QuotaExceeded (CPUS_EXTENDED_GPUS)
Autoscaler: retry backoff 30s
Autoscaler: pending queue growth -> 4200
```

maria_g: running `gcloud compute regions describe us-west3 --project=redwood-prod` now. seeing gpuAcceleratorQuota at limit and regional cpus still reserved.

maria_g: opened case with GCP Support (case: 20471234) requesting quota bump and emergency review. ETA currently unknown. included logs and a note about customer impact.

aj_s: routing change in progress: updated route-policy to prefer us-west2 for model-redwood-7b for anonymous/low-ttl requests. pushing canary now.

ellie_p: to avoid coldstart cost, can we temporarily spin up smaller GPU shapes (g4 instead of g5) and run low-priority batches there? possible perf regression but better than 503s.
samir_k: +1. can we also enable CPU fallback for small prompt sizes for non-latency-sensitive requests?

maria_g: attempting create in us-west2 warm-pool: `gcloud compute instances create-from-machine-image ... --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1`

k8s-autoscaler-bot: Warm pool claim result: partial success. 2 of 4 warm instances provisioned in us-west2, 2 failed due to quota on GPUs in that zone.

aj_s: updating traffic weights: 60% us-west3 (degraded), 30% us-west2, 10% ap-southeast1. applying graceful degradation policy: downsample non-critical sampling to preserve tokens for paid workloads.

ops_lead: implement short-term throttling policy: rate-limit anonymous/free-tier to 20rps per region. mariA, put ACL and rate-limits via edge config and push ASAP.
maria_g: edge config change pushed. CloudFront edge rule updated, rate-limit active. monitoring for errors. :white_check_mark:

priya_m: internal note: support message template drafted for affected hosted customers; will send with mitigation summary + ETA for provider quota response.
samir_k: posting to status.redwood.io draft now: \"We are experiencing degraded performance in US-WEST3 due to cloud GPU quota limits. We are routing traffic to alternative regions and applying rate-limits to reduce impact. Working with provider for quota increase.\"

aj_s: quick sanity check on autoscaler logs after routing change:
```
Autoscaler: pending queue -> 1800 (down from 4200)
Provision attempts -> new attempts routed to us-west2/us-east1
GCP API: recent responses -> 2 success, 4 quotaDenied
```

maria_g: found remaining pressure from warm pools that couldn't spin due to per-project GPU quota. filing internal runbook ticket: RB-3821. include steps for manual quota escalate and fallback options.

ellie_p: ops decision: enable model-variant fallback for high-cost models: redwood-70b -> redwood-7b-slim for best-effort generation for free-tier. Config change approved, rolling canary.

ops_lead: who can open AWS/Azure fallback option tickets? if GCP ETA is long, we should bring up spare capacity in other clouds.
aj_s: i can create AWS spare pool using existing credits. but note: provisioning in a different cloud requires image compatibility work; estimate 18-24m. starting that now.

priya_m: customer impact update: 40 customers reported anomalies, 3 enterprise accounts flagged directly. Priority support on calls for those 3. no SLA breach yet but risk of mitigation if duration > 30m.

maria_g: GCP support updated case: they acknowledged and set priority P2, assigned quota engineer. provisional increase requested: +120 GPUs in us-west3. ETA: 2-6 hours (not guaranteed).

k8s-autoscaler-bot: New autoscaler action: reclaim idle GPU nodes from low-priority pools (eviction policy=claimback) initiated. reclaimed 6 nodes, rebalanced.

aj_s: reclaimed nodes brought pending queue down to ~900. latency trending down to +4s over baseline. error rate dropping.

ops_lead: good progress. short-term mitigation summary (to add to incident timeline): routing fallback, warm-pool claims, rate-limit free-tier, reclaim low-priority GPUs, model-variant fallback, open provider case.
samir_k: I'll own external comms and update customers every 30m until resolved.

ellie_p: postmortem TODOs: tighten quota dashboards, automate cross-region failover for hosted-only pools, add pre-approved provider escalation flow to reduce ETA, runbook updates.

maria_g: tracking ticket created for remediation: INC-8753. assigning to infra-scaling team.

ops_lead: if GCP doesn't respond in 2h, escalate to account team and consider enforcement of paid-customer-first routing more strictly.

priya_m: status page published and customer updates sent. still monitoring.

incident-bot: ROOT STATUS: mitigation in progress, partial recovery observed, impact reduced from 11% to ~2% error rate for hosted API. next update in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
